sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 31 points from 13 games, travel to AFC Bridgnorth on Saturday 24 October at 15:00. Sandbach are in exceptional form, having won their last four league matches and drawn one before that; they will be looking to extend their lead at the summit against a Bridgnorth side sitting fifth in the table with 24 points.
divisionWide: Saturday's remaining fixtures see several mid-table and lower-order sides in action. Stafford Town, currently third with 25 points, host struggling Shawbury United, who occupy 15th place and are winless in their last five league matches. Brereton Social (13th) face Dawley Town (10th) in a basement-area encounter, while Cheadle Heath Nomads (12th) take on Market Drayton Town (14th, joint-lowest) — another lower-table clash. Foley Meir entertain Widnes Town in a match between two of the division's weakest performers, both searching for consistent form. On Tuesday 27 October, Telford Town host Eccleshall; Telford sit second-to-bottom with just 7 points from 12 games, while Eccleshall, in 7th place with 22 points, arrive as strong favorites.
